# Terms of Service — WAGMI

**Last updated**: September 28, 2026

*Leggi in [italiano](./terms-of-service).*

Welcome to WAGMI. By using the app, you accept these Terms of Service. If you do not accept them, you may not use WAGMI.

## 1. The service

WAGMI is a fitness app that lets you log your workouts, get support from an AI-based coach, share your progress with a community, and connect with other users.

**WAGMI does not provide medical advice.** Content generated by the AI Coach, workout suggestions, and any other information in the app are for informational and motivational purposes only: they do not replace the advice of a doctor, physiotherapist, or other qualified professional. Consult a doctor before starting any exercise program, especially if you have pre-existing health conditions.

## 2. Your account

- You must be at least 18 years old to create an account: WAGMI includes Community social features (finding people who train near you, friends, chat and the option to look for dating and relationships), location sharing, and the ability to chat and meet in person with unknown users. You will be asked to confirm this during registration.
- You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure.
- The information you provide during registration must be truthful.
- You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Account Settings — deletion is permanent and immediate.

## 3. Content you post

You retain ownership of the content you post (posts, comments, photos, videos, routines). By posting it on WAGMI, you grant us a non-exclusive license to display it within the app to other users according to the visibility settings you choose, for as long as the content stays published.

You are solely responsible for what you post. You may not post content that:
- violates the law or the rights of others (including copyright and privacy)
- contains spam, harassment, offensive content, non-consensual nudity, violence, or hate speech
- impersonates another person or provides false information

The full detail of what is not allowed, and what happens if you post it anyway, is in our **[Community Guidelines](./community-guidelines-en)** (zero tolerance for offensive content and abusive users) — an integral part of these Terms.

## 4. Moderation

We reserve the right to remove any content and to suspend or disable any account that violates these Terms or the Community Guidelines, without prior notice when the severity of the violation requires it. Every report we receive is reviewed by an administrator within a short time frame.

## 5. Third-party services

WAGMI relies on a small number of third-party services for specific features (signing in with Google/Apple, importing from Strava, the infrastructure that generates the AI Coach's responses). Their use is described in our [Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy-en).

## 6. Plans and paid features

WAGMI is currently free. In the future we may introduce optional paid features or plans: if and when that happens, we will give you clear notice before any charge, and these Terms will be updated accordingly.

## 7. Limitation of liability

WAGMI is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for injuries, health damage, or other harm arising from the use of workout suggestions or the app's features — physical activity carries inherent risks, and it is your responsibility to assess your own fitness to engage in it.

## 8. Suspension and termination

You can stop using WAGMI and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate your access to the service if you violate these Terms or the Community Guidelines.

## 9. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms over time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the app and ask you to accept them again before you can continue using WAGMI.

## 10. Governing law

These Terms are governed by Italian law.
